# The Penny Hoarder

> A premier personal finance platform helping people earn more, save more, and manage money better through guides, tools, courses, and a remote jobs board.

The Penny Hoarder is a comprehensive personal finance resource offering practical advice on income generation, budgeting, debt management, and savings strategies. The site features educational content through its Academy, a curated remote jobs board, and extensive guides on financial topics for beginners to advanced users.

## Key Topics

- personal finance
- side gigs
- work-from-home

- money-saving tips

- budgeting apps

## Core Platforms & Hubs

- [The Penny Hoarder Homepage](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com): Premier personal finance site for making and saving money
- [The Penny Hoarder Academy](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/academy): Personal finance courses on budgeting, credit, homebuying and financial education
- [Make Money Hub](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/make-money): Side gigs, work-from-home jobs, career tips and income opportunities
- [Remote Jobs Board](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/wfh): Filterable work-from-home opportunities with scam detection and pay filters
- [Save Money Hub](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/save-money): Budgeting, frugal living, money-saving tips and cost reduction strategies
- [Budgeting Hub](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting): Budgeting apps, methods, money management and financial planning resources
- [Debt Hub](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/debt): Debt management, consolidation, payoff strategies and relief options

## Income & Career Guides

- [Side Gigs Archives](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/make-money/side-gigs): Flexible work, part-time jobs, and gig economy opportunities
- [Quick Money Archives](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/make-money/quick-money): Earn fast, money-making apps, and passive income strategies
- [Start a Business Archives](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/make-money/start-a-business): Entrepreneurship, business ideas, and small business guides
- [Career Archives](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/make-money/career): Job search, resume writing, interview tips, and career advancement advice

## Budgeting & Money Management Guides

- [How To Budget: 4 Simple Steps](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting/how-to-budget): Tutorial with four simple steps to create a household budget for beginners
- [How to Budget Money: A Guide for Beginners](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting/budgeting-for-beginners): Five steps to budget money, track expenses, and choose budgeting methods
- [Best Budgeting Apps of 2026](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting/best-budgeting-apps): Comparison of best budgeting apps including Rocket Money and Monarch
- [Best Budgeting Apps for Couples](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting/best-budgeting-apps-couples): Guide to best budgeting apps for couples managing joint finances
- [13 Budgeting Tips](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/budgeting/budgeting-tips): Expert budgeting strategies to control spending and reach financial goals

## Saving & Money-Saving Guides

- [How to Save Money: Simple Ways to Start Today](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/save-money/how-to-save-money): Simple, practical ways to save money with step-by-step strategies
- [8 Best Money Saving Apps](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/save-money/money-saving-apps): Review of best money-saving apps including Rakuten and Ibotta for 2026
- [116 Birthday Freebies](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/save-money/birthday-freebies): Comprehensive list of 116 free food and restaurant deals for celebrations

## Debt Management Guides

- [What Is Debt? Definition, Types and How It Works](https://www.thepennyhoarder.com/debt/what-is-debt): Definition of debt types, how debt works, interest rates and credit impact
